content.title: -ing / -ed 形式作状语·主被动速查
content.intro: 分词作状语表时间/原因/结果/伴随。判断口诀:逻辑主语(=主句主语)主动发出动作→ -ing;承受动作或处于被动状态→ -ed。Running fast, he won.(主动)/ Encouraged by fans, he played on.(被动)

rows: 主语主动做:Hearing the whistle, the players stopped.(听到=主动)
主语被…:Beaten in the final, the team felt sad.(被打败)
动作先于主句且主动:Having trained hard, she won the title.
分词的逻辑主语必须就是主句主语:Running fast, HE won.(不是 the ball)

specialRules.rule: 主语主动发出动作 → 用 -ing
specialRules.mark: Running towards the goal, he shot.(他主动跑)

specialRules.rule: 主语承受动作 / 被动 → 用 -ed
specialRules.mark: Encouraged by the coach, he played on.(他被鼓励)

specialRules.rule: 分词逻辑主语 = 主句主语,否则就是错句(垂悬分词)
specialRules.mark: Seen from the stand, the players looked tiny.(被看的是 players)

specialRules.rule: 动作先于主句且主动 → 用 Having done
specialRules.mark: Having scored, she ran to her teammates.

why: -ing 表'主动/正在',-ed 表'被动/已完成受动'。先找出分词的逻辑主语(几乎总是主句主语),再问:这个主语是'做'这个动作,还是'被'这个动作?做→-ing,被→-ed。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:给出动词原形,据主语主被动填 -ing 或 -ed。
辨析重点:主语与分词动作的主被动关系;垂悬分词(逻辑主语不一致)是常见错误。

examVsReal.exam: Encouraged by his coach, he kept going.(书面/考试)
examVsReal.real: His coach encouraged him, so he kept going.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考分词状语;口语里常直接用并列句或 because 从句,更直白

examVsReal.exam: Running fast, he reached the line first.(考试)
examVsReal.real: He ran fast and reached the line first.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 -ing 状语;日常口语更常用并列动词
